Last Vehicle v1.13 audio additions

Original compositions, procedural synthesis, and arrangement/edits in this folder were authored for Last Vehicle. To the extent copyright applies, these original contributions are dedicated under CC0 1.0 Universal.

The source recordings remain under their existing CC0-1.0 dedication. Authors: qubodup (motor fan), Brian MacIntosh / BMacZero (metal clank and rattle), Kenney (interface switch), Independent.nu (dripping water, uploaded by qubodup), Joseph Sardin / BigSoundBank (metallic door creak), and rubberduck (spring strain and metal slam).

This dedication concerns the eight lv113-* Ogg files and audio-v113 authoring work. It does not change the license of the rest of the project. Exact original files, pages, archive/input hashes and existing license notices are preserved in source-lock.json and manifest-snippet.json.

CC0 summary: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
CC0 legal code: dist/assets/licenses/CC0-1.0.txt in this project.
